palette.primary_role: Page background (soft blush/cream, warm white — never stark white, always with warmth)
palette.accent_role: CTA buttons (gold/copper/champagne), decorative elements, price highlights, section dividers
palette.surface_role: Card backgrounds (warm white with blush undertones), modal backgrounds, form fields
palette.neutral_role: Body text (warm taupe/rose-gray, never pure black which is too harsh), secondary info
palette.border_role: Card borders, input borders, dividers (soft warm beige, barely visible — delicate)

button_styles.text: Schedule a Tour, Inquire Now, Book Your Date, Request Pricing, Start Planning
View Gallery, Learn More, See Packages, Read Our Story
Navigation, social links, fine print, vendor directory

elevation.approach: Shadows should feel like soft candlelight — barely there, warm-toned if possible. Nothing harsh or angular.

typical_order: header (transparent over hero or soft cream bg, logo/name center, nav below, subtle gold accents, thin font)
hero (full-bleed couple photo or venue photo + couple names or venue name + tagline + subtle CTA + scroll indicator)
services (elegant 3-column cards: planning, design, coordination, florals, catering — icon optional but delicate)
gallery (masonry or justified grid of wedding photos, soft lightbox on click, category filter: ceremonies/receptions/details)
packages (3-tier packages: name + price + inclusions list, elegant table or card layout, 'Most Popular' badge)
testimonials (quote cards: italic quote + couple names + wedding date + photo, carousel with soft fade)
inquiry_form (centered, generous whitespace, soft bg, 'Let's Start Planning' + name/email/date/venue fields + submit)
footer (centered: venue/planner name, Instagram grid, contact info, social icons, copyright — elegant and minimal)
hero_variants: couple_portrait (romantic — full-bleed couple photo, names centered in elegant serif, soft warm overlay, 'Our Story' CTA)
venue_panorama (venue style — wide shot of ceremony or reception space, venue name, 'Schedule a Tour' CTA)
detail_collage (florist/decorator style — collage of close-up detail shots: flowers, table settings, rings, fabric)
video_background (cinematic — slow-motion wedding highlight reel, minimal text, emotional connection first)
feature_card_variants: service_card (delicate icon or photo + service title + poetic description + 'Learn More' link, soft border, 3-column)
package_card (package name + price + feature list with checkmarks, highlighted recommended tier, gold border accent)
gallery_thumbnail (image-only card with soft hover overlay showing caption/category, masonry layout)
testimonial_card (centered italic quote + couple name + date, generous padding, decorative quote marks, optional small photo)

tone_profile.headline_style: romantic and evocative, 5-8 words (e.g., 'Where Forever Begins.', 'Love Stories, Beautifully Told.')
tone_profile.cta_style: gentle, invitational (Inquire, Schedule a Visit, Let's Connect, Start Planning Your Dream, Book Your Date)
trust_signals: featured in publications (The Knot, Martha Stewart Weddings)

color_mood: blush_romance (#fdf8f5 blush cream, #d4a0a0 dusty rose, #c9a96e champagne gold, #6b5b5b warm taupe — classic romantic)
garden_botanical (#f7f3e8 warm white, #8b9d7d sage green, #d4a574 copper, #5c4c3c bark — outdoor/garden weddings)
coastal_breeze (#f5f8fa cool white, #a3b5c8 dusty blue, #c9a96e sand gold, #6b7c8e slate — beach/destination weddings)
modern_luxe (#faf9f8 clean cream, #2c2416 espresso, #d4a574 champagne, #e5e0d8 stone — modern minimalist)
vintage_rose (#fdf4f0 antique blush, #c4736e vintage rose, #b8860b dark gold, #5c4c4c cocoa — vintage/rustic weddings)
typography_mood: cormorant_romance (Cormorant Garamond headings, Lato body — timeless, editorial, most versatile wedding font pairing)
playfair_elegance (Playfair Display headings, Jost body — polished, luxury venues and high-end planners)
bodoni_glamour (Bodoni Moda headings, Work Sans body — high-contrast, dramatic, fashion-forward bridal)
layout_density: editorial_airy (large imagery, poetic text, generous whitespace — high-end planners and venues)
portfolio_grid (gallery-heavy, image-first browsing, minimal text — photographers and florists)
planner_structured (clear packages, pricing visible, form accessible — working wedding planners and venues)

gallery_page.best_practices: Masonry or justified grid, soft category filters, lazy loading with elegant fade-in, lightbox with swipe on mobile

packages_page.best_practices: 3-4 tiers, clear inclusions/exclusions, 'Most Popular' highlight, FAQ accordion, no hard sell — weddings don't respond to pressure
